title: Ball State finally gets one
lines: Ball State finally got one. Eighty-nine to sixty-four over Brescia, at Worthen Arena. Pastor, your Cardinals are one and two.
Matthew, Pastor Rodney Bumrod has been praying on this since the bus left Georgia Southern. Brescia came to Muncie, and Muncie sent 'em home. As it were.
For the record, Brescia is an N A I A school. Ball State was supposed to win this one by a lot.

Pastor, they did not make me at all. But thank you. Sean Blake had twenty points and five assists.
